method: Official public product pages, help documentation and vendor announcements via web search/open; no paid account access or internal competitor reverse engineering.
scope: 23 vendor/product entries, bounded competitive set, not exhaustive market inventory. Products are not necessarily independent corporate entities.
evidence_limitations: Vendor-advertised functionality is not independently verified production capability.
No external competitor pricing contract, customer tenant, latency, model weights or proprietary source code inspected.
Search crawler timestamps are not product release dates.
No future-dated announcement was used to establish current capability. Navigation may promote 2027 content without dating current functionality.

After retrieval follow-up,22 of23 primary vendor pages have substantive official body content retrieved through web.open, Jina Reader or REA. Mintel primary product page remained unavailable but its official2024 launch body was opened. Numerator supplemental help page S03 remains search-index-only after401. Retrieval success does not independently verify paid product behavior.
